title: BRK Financial Group says technical investigations confirmed unauthorised access to its MyBRK portal server
date_note: Date of the company's follow-up exchange report as relayed by Actual de Cluj; BRK's first report of 2 Nov says the incident was identified on 30 Oct.
geo_basis: company headquarters as stated by the source
summary: BRK Financial Group, formerly SSIF Broker, told the Bucharest Stock Exchange that technical investigations confirmed unauthorised access to the server of its my.brk.ro portal; Actual de Cluj says this allowed viewing of the database and documents in the application. BRK's first report says no unauthorised transactions on client accounts or assets were identified and that it is analysing any impact on personal data. BRK says the affected application was isolated.
plain: BRK says someone gained unauthorised access to the server of its online account-opening portal, which is unavailable. It says it has not found unauthorised transactions and is assessing any impact on personal data.
exec: A listed Romanian broker confirms unauthorised access to its account-opening portal server; it is still assessing any impact on personal data.
action: BRK says it will notify directly any individuals found to be affected; clients can open accounts at BRK offices and agencies or through delegated agents meanwhile.

sources.name: BVB: BRK, Informare privind un incident de securitate cibernetica (report 3537/02.11.2026)

validation.note: BRK's own exchange report (2 Nov) read; the 20 Nov follow-up is known only through Actual de Cluj, which quotes it.

review.note: stronger than the source: server was isolated -> report says the affected application was isolated; rest checked against BVB report and Actual de Cluj
